findings.finding: Q3 2026 was pre-released on 28 Sep (growth 16-17% SEK, adj. EBIT margin ~5.5%), so the reported quarter lands on a number the market already has.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The pre-release itself moved +2.7% and +3.1% (29-30 Sep), then -6.1% on 1 Oct; the previously pre-released quarters reported at -1.6% (Q4 2024, 2025-02-07) and -7.4% / -6.0% (H1 2026, 14 and 17 Aug 2026). Yahoo daily bars.
findings.why_not_priced: It IS priced: a MAR inside-information release the stock reacted to over three sessions. Filed at 0 so that nothing else is sized on it.
findings.independence: Placera/Nyhetsbyrån Direkt Swedish wire carries the same figures, https://www.placera.se/telegram/boozt-justerar-upp-helarsprognosen-for-2026-oms-20260929 (same document, not independent)

findings.finding: On 26 Oct, with about 3.5 weeks of October trading visible and the company having flagged September front-loading, Boozt moved its FY adj. EBIT margin guide to the high end of 6.5-7.0% instead of warning, a mild signal that the Q4 start is not weak; most of it is the cost saving and it was traded at +2.9% that day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin-guide raises on results days: Q3 2025 +1.5%, Q1 2026 +8.6%; the 26 Oct update itself +2.9% on 846k shares (about 10x normal).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced (the +2.9% day). What remains is the inference that October trading supported the high end; if the market had fully read that, a Q4-commentary 'in line' would be a non-event, which it probably is.

findings.finding: The 9-12% cc FY revenue guide, after ~11% cc in 9M and 16% in Q3, implies Q4 growth anywhere from roughly +7% to +15% (my arithmetic off the reported 9M and FY2025 revenue), so a narrowing of the revenue range toward its upper half in the release is plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Revenue-guide raises: June 2026 pre-release +6.0%, 28 Sep pre-release +2.7%/+3.1%; revenue guide narrowed DOWN in Q3 2025 (to 0-3%) with the margin guide raised, +1.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: sell-side models probably sit in the upper half already. A narrowing is the company's choice and not certain; the company's own front-loading caveat ('Favorable weather conditions in September may have front-loaded the AW26 trading') argues for leaving the range wide, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: FY2025 revenue and 9M figures from the H1 2026 report, https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b59675284c44c8f9dda5eea8e0c5a38f1&lang=en&src=listed (same issuer)

findings.finding: The H1 report said inventory was already above last year and a further ramp-up was planned during Q3, so Q3 free cash flow and working capital will compare badly with Q3 2025's SEK 292m, which clearance sales flattered.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2026: FCF SEK 39m (186) on the inventory build, reported alongside +13% growth and margin +3.1pp, and the stock fell 7.4% and 6.0%. Whether FCF caused that drop is not established, and the reaction is counted in the positioning finding, not here.
findings.why_not_priced: The company guided to the build, so the direction is known. The size of the cash swing and inventory turns is not in any pre-release, and the pre-release spoke only of growth and margin. If the market had priced it, the H1 FCF line would not have coincided with a 13% two-day drop.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 FCF of SEK 292m comparison base, https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bae33c1977e2a117df5476804394b8ccb&lang=en&src=listed

findings.finding: Sell-the-news setup: the one exact precedent (Q2 pre-released 29 Jun with a guide raise, H1 report on 14 Aug with the guide merely confirmed) fell 7.4% and then 6.0%, two sell-side houses (SEB, Danske) cut to hold at SEK 160 citing a priced-in story, and the stock has run +10% in 20 days to 158, at those targets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pre-released periods on report day: Q4 2024 -1.6% (after the 2 Jan 2025 update at +4.0%), H1 2026 -7.4% then -6.0%. Yahoo BOOZT.ST daily bars.
findings.original_quote: SEB sänker rekommendationen för e-handelsbolaget Boozt till behåll från köp och justerar ned riktkursen till 160 kronor (163). Banken anser att den starka kursutvecklingen under 2026 innebär att en stor del av bolagets positiva utveckling redan är inprisad. ... Under morgonen har även Danske Bank sänkt Boozt till behåll (köp) med en ny riktkurs på 160 kronor (135). [SEB cuts Boozt to hold from buy, target SEK 160 (163); the strong 2026 share performance means much of the positive development is already priced in. Danske Bank also cut to hold (buy), target SEK 160 (135).]
findings.why_not_priced: The run-up says the market is long into the print, not that it expects a sell-off. The short register (1.04%, flat) shows no one positioned for a drop. A one-precedent pattern is weak, hence the small size and wide range.

findings.finding: Capital return: the SEK 300m 2026 buyback limit was 89% used by end-H1 (SEK 268m), and the Q3 2025 and H1 2026 reports both expanded the programme, so a further expansion or a new capital-return target is plausible in this release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Buyback expansions came with Q3 2025 (+1.5%) and H1 2026 (-7.4%), so they have not visibly driven the day.
findings.why_not_priced: Not announced. Inferred from the issuer's own pattern and its remaining headroom. Small, because buybacks have not moved this stock on report days and Q3 buyback use is unknown (the inventory ramp may have absorbed cash).
